prompt:
You receive 2 images. Image 1 is a finished background painting of our point-and-click adventure game: the upper-floor panoramic lounge of the Rotunda on Chopok, view north to the High Tatras, painted in summer 2035. Image 2 is the same painting with coloured boxes that only mark the interactive objects, the exits and the walkable floor, which must all stay exactly where they are. Edit image 1 into the SAME PLACE on 6 February 2035, a clear cold day in deep winter, seen by the SAME CAMERA: keep the exact viewpoint, lens, horizon, perspective and framing, and keep the position, size and outline of every building, wall, door, window, pole, rail, sign, piece of furniture, object and tree trunk. Change only what winter changes, as described below. Keep the painting technique, brushwork, palette handling and level of detail of image 1.

Inside the lounge everything stays exactly as in image 1 (the dark blue sofas, the tub chairs and tables, the
normalisation panel the box labelled 'Panel normalizácie' in image 2 (x 470-720, y 360-660 of the 1920x1080 frame (24-38 % from the left, 33-61 % from the top)) with its pictograms, the bell showcase the box labelled 'Vitrína zvončeka' in image 2 (x 1005-1155, y 450-730 of the 1920x1080 frame (52-60 % from the left, 42-68 % from the top)), the stone wall with
the empty gilt frame the box labelled 'Prázdny rám' in image 2 (x 1325-1505, y 295-540 of the 1920x1080 frame (69-78 % from the left, 27-50 % from the top)), the glazed door the box labelled 'exit: Servisný pavilón výstavy Atlas' in image 2 (x 1600-1790, y 360-705 of the 1920x1080 frame (83-93 % from the left, 33-65 % from the top)), the floor). Winter shows only through the
big curved window wall:
- The High Tatras on the horizon keep their exact outline but are fully white winter mountains with blue shadows; the
  Liptov basin below is white with snow, the lake frozen and white, the forests dark and dusted with snow.
- The rocks and the dwarf pines right outside the windows (bottom left and bottom right of the window wall) are under
  deep snow with white rime; snow drifts against the outside of the glass at the bottom.
- The two Funitel pylons and the ropes at the left stay where they are, coated with white rime; one dark Funitel cabin
  hangs on the ropes between the pylons, going down.
- Clear deep winter blue sky; frost flowers in the lower corners of the panes and a thin frost rim along the frames.
Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1920, y 738-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 68-94 % from the top) stays the same open floor. The exit the box labelled 'exit: Kabína Funitelu medzi Priehybou a Chopkom' in image 2 (x 0-60, y 738-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-3 % from the left, 68-94 % from the top)) at the left edge stays open.
This room has no NPC zones.

Fiction rules: no new lettering, no logos, no people, no animals.

Image 2 is a positioning aid only: do NOT draw any of its boxes, outlines, labels or captions. The result is image 1 edited, in the same 16:9 framing: no frames, no borders, no UI, no captions, no watermark, no text except the lettering already in image 1, and no people or animals unless stated above.

Lighting: a clear, cold, sunny winter day in the Low Tatras mountains: deep clean blue sky, low winter sun, crisp blue-violet shadows on the snow, sparkle on fresh snow, cold bright air. The brushwork, line quality and palette harmony stay exactly those of image 1 (style A).

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
